I replied to Marcus in his #north-random thread to confirm his correction: the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 19 November, not the date he posted in #north-team this morning.

He asked for no action, so that reply is the only thing I did. I didn't read #north-team, change his earlier post or save anything separately in gbrain. Messages posted in channels are saved to gbrain automatically, so his correction is already recorded there.
